Seamless 360 degree cylindrical panorama strip, a skybox backdrop for a stylised video game with the stylised realism of a modern Nintendo golf game: believable light and atmosphere, bold saturated colour, slightly painterly. A perfectly straight level horizon line runs across the whole image at one fifth of the height from the bottom edge. Below the horizon only a dark basalt plain veined with thin glowing lava rivers. Above it an ember-lit caldera sky at dusk: deep maroon and charcoal ash clouds lit from underneath in orange and red, a band of fiery orange along the whole horizon, drifting sparks. Three distant volcano cones stand around the horizon, each erupting with a lava fountain and a tall ash plume, none taller than one fifth of the image height. A dim blood-orange sun hangs low in the left third, veiled by smoke. No foreground objects, no people, no animals, no text, no logos, no real landmarks, no lens flare streaks, no vignette, no frame. The left edge and the right edge match exactly so the strip wraps around seamlessly.
